recommendation: Keep indexing off by default and F4 gated. This fixture shows no fact-coverage benefit from optional retrieval, and median paired time and tool use increase. Unknown usage prevents an exact overall token-cost conclusion.
limitations: Every recorded failure is retained; historical attempts never enter new matched contrasts.
Facts are keyword coverage, not an independent semantic answer-quality assessment.
Cache and helper checkpoint counters are subsets and are never added again to actual input/output tokens.
Unknown or unassigned transport usage is not inferred into an exact pair.
Task wall time excludes separately recorded index builds. Request durations can overlap and are not added to task wall time.
Three repeats per task provide limited evidence; this report makes no statistical-significance claim.

components.input_framing: Internal LF whitespace-normalized before plain-composer submission

aggregation.meaning: Raw component counts and exits are preserved. A new component with 26 selected cells may have raw expected_runs 30, complete=false and exit 1 while the independently validated aggregate has 30 eligible cells.

decision.basis: No additional expected facts in any pair; both arms pass 12/15 contracts; on has 90/102 facts versus 92/102 off. Median paired on-minus-off is +6.5 seconds and +6 tool calls.
decision.scope: Five tasks in one pinned repository, one model/effort setting, three repetitions; no statistical-significance or general model-quality claim.

harness_followup.production_change: Normalize internal CRLF/CR/LF to spaces before one final plain-chat submission newline.
